compos.summarization: The smartphone UI screen displays a form for entering a vehicle number. The instructions at the top explain how to input the vehicle number correctly, using an example format. There are two text input fields for entering the vehicle number in two parts. Below the input fields, there is a green "SEARCH" button to submit the entered information. Additionally, there are notifications at the top and bottom of the screen indicating that the device storage is almost full, with a prompt to clean it. The on-screen keyboard is visible at the bottom, allowing the user to type in the vehicle number.
